timeline.summary: On 12 May 2026 Bliss GVS Pharma reported postal ballot results: shareholders passed both special resolutions appointing Vijayanarayanan Mahadevan and Deepak Rameshchandra Shah as Non-Executive Independent Directors for five years, with 99.72% of votes polled in favour.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹256.99 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹35.58 Cr.
On 23 May 2026, Bliss GVS Pharma announced an open offer by Anupam Rasayan India Limited following a 43.30% promoter stake purchase agreement at ₹299 per share.
On 2 June 2026 Bliss GVS Pharma said its Palghar (East), Maharashtra manufacturing facility received a WHO Geneva Inspection Closure Report confirming WHO-GMP compliance.
